description: List your standing wants, with how many matches each has surfaced and when it last re-ran. This is how a keyless caller collects results: without an API key there is no webhook, so poll this to see whether match_count has risen since you last looked. Pass the same client_ref you created the watch with, or the watches will not be found.

client_ref.description: The same opaque reference you passed to demand.create_watch. Required to find keyless watches; ignored when you send an API key.

name: demand.list_watches

id.description: Pass to demand.cancel_watch to stop it.

match_count.description: Distinct matches surfaced over its life. Rising means new supply appeared.

title: List your standing wants
